messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out release v2026-03-19-3 to production in the 21:00-22:00 change window. Canary: 10% -> 30%

maria: canaries failing on request path /api/generate, error 500 after first token emitted 

kevin: seeing lots of 500s in prod canary logs: stacktrace points to kms decrypt error when loading customer keys 

olivia: strange — staging didn't show this earlier. ran the config-checker and it reported missing KMS key in staging.

samir: paste from local diff: 
```
prod: 
  KMS_KEY_ID: kms-prod-abc123
  FEATURE_FLAG_NEW_ROUTING: "true"
  MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES: 2097152
staging:
  KMS_KEY_ID: <absent>
  FEATURE_FLAG_NEW_ROUTING: "false"
  MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES: 1048576
```

jenni: wow. so staging and prod diverged on secrets + feature flag. config-sync job should have synced secrets — last run shows error at 19:45 about permissions.

oncall-sre: deploy-bot triggered alert for increased 5xx rate. recommendation: rollback canary to previous stable (v2026-03-12-7) until we confirm secret sync. :warning:

maria: agree. we should rollback the canary and abort further rollout. also pin the release-level env spec so we don't accidentally reapply broken config.

kevin: rollback command then: `deploy-bot rollback --release v2026-03-19-3 --to v2026-03-12-7 --scope canary`

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Initiating rollback of canary for v2026-03-19-3 -> v2026-03-12-7. Will post status updates.

maria: after rollback, we need a postmortem action list: 1) fix config-sync permission issue, 2) run end-to-end staging smoke that includes KMS decrypt, 3) pin config schema in the release artifact, 4) add a gating check in release notes that confirms secrets present.

olivia: adding to release notes draft now: "HOTFIX: Reverted v2026-03-19-3 canary due to missing KMS_KEY_ID in staging leading to production 5xx. Do not reattempt rollout until config-sync permissions are fixed and smoke tests pass."

samir: also: we should consider requiring `rctl config diff --require-identical-secrets` as part of the deploy pipeline for change windows. saved me once.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: canary percentage set to 0% for v2026-03-19-3. Traffic resumed on v2026-03-12-7 canary nodes.

oncall-sre: confirm monitoring: 5xx rate back to baseline. good.

maria: assigning follow-ups: KEVIN -> investigate config-sync failure and re-run with debug logs (ticket INFRA-4821). OLIVIA -> add secret-presence gate to release docs. SAMIR -> propose pipeline change for secret diffs and pinning. JENNI -> coordinate next change window for re-deploy after fixes.

jenni: noted, I'll book a 1-hour change window for tomorrow 20:00-21:00 for a controlled reattempt and tag it as "config-sync verification".

kevin: quick root cause: config-sync IAM role lost read access to KMS alias due to recent policy churn from a permissions cleanup patch. Fix involves re-granting kms:Decrypt to the config-sync role and re-running the sync.

maria: thanks. once fixed: run these steps in order in staging: `rctl sync`, `rctl config diff staging prod`, smoke tests (generate, streaming), then canary rollout with 5% increments.

olivia: I'll update the release notes and send the revised rollout plan. tagging @oncall-sre for follow-up on the rollback postmortem. :white_check_mark: 

oncall-sre: I'll draft a short incident blurb for the status page: 'briefly elevated 5xx due to config drift; rollback performed; no data loss.'

maria: closing thread for now. keep updates here as PRs/tickets progress. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
